definition_quote.value: All piping, fixtures, appurtenances, and appliances in connection with a supply of water within or adjacent to any building, structure, or conveyance on the premises...; for sanitary drainage or storm drainage facilities...; used in the installation of natural gas; and the installation, repair, maintenance, and renovation of all piping, fixtures, appurtenances, and appliances for a supply of water or for the disposal of waste water, liquid waste, or sewage.
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing" means: (A) All piping, fixtures, appurtenances, and appliances: (i) In connection with a supply of water within or adjacent to any building, structure, or conveyance on the premises... (iii) Used in the installation of natural gas; and (B) The installation, repair, maintenance, and renovation of all piping, fixtures, appurtenances, and appliances for a supply of water or for the disposal of waste water, liquid waste, or sewage
